subject: Confirmation of Hotel Reservation
body: Dear valued guest, Thank you for choosing to stay with us at Paradise Beach Resort. This email is to confirm your reservation for a deluxe ocean-view room from June 15th to June 20th. Your booking includes complimentary breakfast and access to our exclusive beach club. We look forward to welcoming you to our resort and ensuring you have a memorable stay. Should you have any questions or special requests, please feel free to contact us. We wish you safe travels and a wonderful vacation!
